subject: Class 450 in South Western Railway's painted livery
method: Side elevation from N0thhan's SWR painted-livery diagram (dia), axes calibrated separately; the front first estimated on p082 at about 200 px/m, then measured onto the model's shell through cameras solved from bodyside points on p031 and p113 (match.py surface); colours from p031 normalised to the first-class door's leaf.

calibration.notes: Horizontal: cab car 83..1708 px and car 2 1765..3398 px both taken as 20.34 m (published) -> 79.9 and 80.3 px/m. Vertical: rail at row 338.5, roof at row 31 (3.78 m published) -> 81.3 px/m. Window edges are the outer edges of their black frames.

trace.heights: dia col 670: window frames rows 92-183 (3.03-1.91 m); navy to row 258, yellow line 258-261 (0.99-0.95 m), underframe from 262 (0.94 m); door col 470: leaves rows 65-261 (3.36-0.95), blue top band 62-65, yellow outline top 58-61 (3.45-3.41)
trace.cab.doors[0]: Joint camera fit (p028, near side-on): cab door outline 1.24-2.05 m (diagram 1.08-1.84); p028 measured locally from heights (door 0.99-3.41 m = 319 px, yaw about 15 degrees): 0.80 m wide, 1.46 m from its rear to the next window's glass; window about half the door's width, in two panes (reader 2); its window toward the rear edge (both readers, p016/p028)
trace.cab.doors[1..2]: Joint fit with the two doors' widths tied: door 1 leaves 5.48-7.12 m, door 2 14.89-16.53 m (1.64 m wide; the diagram draws 4.49-6.30 and 13.96-15.76). Leaf windows glass rows 83-176 (2.00-3.14 m)
trace.cab.windows: Joint camera fit (match/joint.json: p028, p031, p113; p031's focal fixed from EXIF, 2439 px; 46 picks, fit rms 1.7-3.3 px, door widths tied): the window ahead of door 1 at 3.53-4.76 m; the saloon windows from 7.72 m to 14.12 m in the diagram's pattern (rescaled; back-projection on p031 puts window fronts at 9.03 and 10.92 m); the two behind door 2 back-projected on p031 at 16.71-17.73 and 18.25-19.52 m. The diagram (glass runs 327-414, 619-721, 755-875, 909-1028, 1062-1164, 1375-1477, 1511-1613 px) draws the cab car's layout about 0.5-1.0 m too far forward; its car 2 is kept. Heights: the photos' windows are the diagram's glass, not its outlines: 1.93-2.96 m
trace.bogies: dia row 325: wheel chords centred 196/386 and 1374/1564 px (cab), 1909/2099 and 3064/3254 (car 2): bogie centres 2.60 and 17.35 m; the drawn wheelbase is 2.38 m against the published 2.6 m: the published figure is used
trace.nose.profile: as before, but the face stays flat to 3.30 m and rolls back through 3.43 m: the old points (0, 3.40) then (0.1, 3.52) made the spline loop forward to 3.60 m and dip back to 3.52 m, a lip across the face's top that broke the paint there
trace.face: First estimate on p082 (near head-on) at about 200 px/m both ways from the roof (sy 178 = 3.78 m) and the screens' centre line (sx 1065); refined by camera (see face.camera)
trace.face.lamps: Joint fit (p028, p031, p113): head 0.79 m from the centre line, 1.59 m up; marker 1.22 m, 1.59 m; tail 1.04 m, 1.42 m (from 0.77/1.10/0.97 first read on p082); three per side, flush on the yellow, each in a thin black ring (readers 1 and 2); confirmed on a 444 (444016, held-out tail 1.8 cm); sizes from the second reader's pair check (render vs 450031/450113): headlamp 1.55x the marker and the tail, so head r 0.13, marker 0.055, tail 0.06 (positions unchanged: they come from the camera fit)
trace.face.gangway: p082 f-gangway-082: frame of bare weathered metal, riveted, sides about 0.2 of the door's width; the door black over yellow, the split straight at 65% of its height down, three vertical seams making four equal panels (reader 2)
trace.face.screens: p031 surface picks (match.py surface, solved camera): the glass's edges stand upright on the real train, inner 0.674-0.675 m and outer 1.286-1.288 m from the centre line, 2.15-2.20 to 3.13-3.16 m up; the frame's outer edge 1.30-1.32 m. The face is drawn in metres of a 1.4 m half-width scaled to the body's width at each height (1.39 m at the glass's foot, 1.33 m at its top: tumblehome), so the same upright edges are glass 0.678 to 0.713 m (inner, foot to top) and 1.293 to 1.359 m (outer), frame outer 1.319 to 1.383 m. The first reading took the real metres as drawn metres, which made the glass 4-10 cm too narrow, worst at the top (review of v3: 'the cab window is larger')
trace.face.number: 450082 head-on (f-face-082, 186 px/m up, 217 px/m across, from the glass): a thin white sans 0.45 m long, caps about 0.10 m tall, centred 0.03 m outboard of the glass's centre (0.985 m out), 0.19 m above the glass top (3.34 m); 450031 (a crop) agrees. Rendered light: Arial thinned, whose caps are 0.72 of `height` and whose six digits run 3.3x it, so height 0.155 (0.14 rendered 12% short of 450031 on the p031 camera); placed from the p031 surface pick (centre 1.034 m out on the real train at 3.34 m, where the body is 1.309 m wide: 1.106 m drawn)
trace.face.lower: 444016 (p016, close three-quarter; 231 px/m across from the lamps' spacing, 308 px/m up from the headlamp) and 450082 head-on (f-face-082; 164 px/m from the face's half-width): under the yellow the face carries on in body colour (navy; green on the 350) for 0.24-0.26 m, to 1.07 m (the valance), a grey anti-climber pad at each corner filling its height (0.90-1.30 m out, 1.08-1.31 m up); below that a ribbed black skirt box each side, eight slats, 0.76-1.30 m out (444016 0.68-1.26, 450082 0.74-1.17 near and 0.88-1.42 far), 1.07 down to 0.45 m (0.49 on 444016, 0.37 on 450082), and between the skirts the open recess the coupler stands in, black up to the gangway frame's foot (1.19 m). The same hardware on 350109 (head-on, Watford Junction). Before: dark from the lamp panel's foot down, one block; the recess is cut 0.16 m back into the chin (which stands 0.18 m proud of the face from 0.5 to 1.0 m), so the skirts either side stand out as boxes and the coupler sits back between them (444016, 450082: the coupler's face is about level with the yellow); its foot at 0.52 m, where the chin's underside turns back
trace.livery: p031 samples normalised to the first-class door leaf as white paint: navy #1C273B (navy-031), white past the diagonal #D3D4D7 in shade (taken as #EDEEF0, the diagram's #F0F0F0); yellow raw from p082 (#EED348; no neutral on the face); door 1 leaves pale cool grey (reader 2: about #B9C3D5 raw) with a sky-blue band over them
trace.livery.crescent: rear edge per row from the diagram (widest 0.78-0.81 m at 3.1-3.3 m); top and foot from the photos, which win over the diagram there: on 450031 (p031, a crop), 450113 and 450082 head-on the yellow ends in a rounded tip level with the number's top where the face meets the roof's curve (3.45-3.50 m), not under the roof at 3.70 m as the diagram draws it, and its rear edge sweeps down into the corner just above the lamp panel (readers 1 and 2: tapering to a point there). The crescent draws only the part facing sideways (livery SW.ts); the corner itself is the face's strip; the tip raised 0.04 m into the roof's curve after review of v3
trace.livery.diagonal: dia: the navy's edge at 13.54 m (3.67), 13.06 (3.06), 12.14 (1.95), 11.94 (1.70): a straight line leaning back about 39 degrees from vertical, down to the navy lower band at 1.37 m; reader 2 (s-diagonal-031): its top corner rounded; carried through the joint fit's map like the windows round it (diagram 6.71-13.55 m -> 7.72-14.12 m), so it meets the fourth window as on 450031 (g31d): [[14.185, 3.78], [12.361, 1.37]]; moved 0.65 m back (second reader, diagonal pair on 450031: the cut starts 0.18 of a door width ahead of door 2, the render's 0.58)
trace.livery.firstLine: dia rows 58-65: yellow 231-441 px (1.85-4.49 m), joining door 1's outline; p028: it starts at the cab door's rear edge, so from 2.06 m
trace.livery.door1: reader 2 (s-door1-031): on 450031 the yellow outline runs over the top and down each side only to about 30% of the door, with a flag on the rear side; on 450113 (g113b) the front edge carries a thin yellow line full height; the diagram draws both full height. Front: full height (diagram, p113); rear: top 30% (p031, p113); the rear edge's outline widens to 0.1 m over the top of the door, down to 2.67 m (the flag; readers); second reader (door1 pair, 450031): no yellow down the front edge, only round its top corner: front edge from 3.2 m
trace.livery.doors: dia and p031: door 1 pale grey (first class), every other passenger door navy, all with a sky-blue band across the top
trace.face.gangwayFrame: Joint fit: the frame's front 0.55 m ahead of the face, half-width 0.60 m, 1.20-3.61 m; p028 shows it on bellows (g28b); bellows black ribbed rubber (p028 g28b, 444016); second reader (face pair on 450031): the frame's border about 0.17 of the door's width per side and it stands 20% less proud: half 0.52 m (0.355 m door), depth 0.45 m; colour a dark neutral grey
trace.roof, under: not measured: the roof pods and underframe boxes as the old data had them (cab 8.5 m)
trace.livery.white: second reader (diagonal pair): the white is a light blue-grey 15-20% darker than pure white, as sampled on p031 (#D3D4D7 balanced to the first-class door): #D5D8DD; roof mid-light grey #A9AEB5
trace.face.strip: 450082 head-on (f-face-082) and 450031/450113: the yellow on the face runs from the screen surround's outer edge (1.32 m, adjacent to the black frame) round the cab corner and up; head-on its band narrows from the corner side over the top 0.1-0.15 m and ends at about 3.40-3.45 m, so the inner edge curves out from the glass top (3.15 m; 450031: it has begun to lean out by the frame's top) to meet the outer edge at 3.40 m, where the crescent takes over: its front edge rounds back onto the side from there to the tip at 3.52 m (one edge, so no step where the two meet). On the side it continues as the crescent (livery.crescent), its top rounded at 3.49 m; the face strip draws the corner, the crescent only the part facing sideways, so the two views never disagree where the renderer blends them
trace.face.surround: head-on 450082: the black frame stands 0.09 m above the glass (17 px at 186 px/m: 3.24 m, clear of the number) and 0.07 m outboard (1.32 m); earlier read through p031/p082 surfaces as 3.26-3.29 m, which put the number on the frame
trace.livery.glass: review of v3 (450031): the windscreen reads as glass inside a black frame; at #1A1D22 it was as dark as the frame and the window read as one black block. #3A4652, a mid blue-grey for glass reflecting a bright sky, as on 450031, 450082 and 450113
trace.livery.branding: SW-roundel ('SW' over the arrow and 'R', traced off 450028 side-on, logos/SOURCES.md): p028 at 131.8 px/m from the cab door's 0.99-3.41 m: 0.41-1.18 m behind the cab door's rear edge (2.45-3.24 m), 2.05-2.86 m up, so centre 2.845, 2.455 and 0.81 m tall (the diagram gives 2.35-3.27, 2.11-2.90). SW-wordmark (the official logo's glyphs set on one line, arrow first; white on the cab car, navy on car 2): p031 back-projected through the joint-fit camera 7.96-12.4 m, 1.43-1.85 m (perspective); diagram 7.54-11.57 m, 1.48-1.79 m: 4.0 m long, so 0.39 m tall at the artwork's 10.3 aspect, centred 9.6 m, 1.63 m; car 2 from the diagram (px 2412-2735 at 80.3 px/m, rows 193-218): centre 10.07 m, 1.635 m
